import random, sys, time
sys.path[:0]=['/workspace/tmp/tests','/opt/emicro-deps','/workspace/project']
from ebpf.create_dfa import create, registry_columns
names=['S%02d'%i for i in range(16)]
reg=[{'name':n,'label':i+1} for i,n in enumerate(names)]
cols,colmap=registry_columns(reg)
rng=random.Random(99)
pool=[tuple(rng.choice(names) for _ in range(8)) for _ in range(6000)]
pool=list(dict.fromkeys(pool))
def rows_for(n):
    txt=' '.join('match(%s) allow;'%','.join(w) for w in pool[:n])
    try:
        img=create(txt,cols,colmap); return len(img.rows), img.cells
    except Exception as e: return ('ERR',type(e).__name__)
# binary search a word count near the 8192 row boundary
lo,hi=2500,3600
t=time.time()
while lo<hi-1:
    mid=(lo+hi)//2
    r=rows_for(mid)
    if isinstance(r[0],int) and r[0]<=8192: lo=mid
    else: hi=mid
print('boundary search %.1fs'%(time.time()-t))
for n in (lo-1,lo,lo+1,hi,hi+1):
    print(n, rows_for(n))
EOF
